name: Succubus Elf Airi-chan
original_name: サキュバスエルフ・アイリちゃん
source:
Having defeated the demon lord, the hero lived a quiet life away from the hassle and bustle.
He lives together with a loli succubus, who sweetly violates him every day...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE288288.html]DLsite English[/url]]

他和一个萝莉魅魔住在一起，每天都甜蜜地侵犯他……
